title: Decision rows
line: See saved judgments in the transcript.

beats.caption: The agent requests a judgment on a proposed check.
Decision rows shows the saved result in one line.
beats.label: pi-decision-rows

beats.caption: Expand tool output to see the saved details.

takeaway.title: Open the details when you need them
takeaway.line: The transcript keeps the result visible alongside the work.

notes: The local judge serves a scripted probability. Pi saves the real decision entry and PI_DECISION_ROWS=all shows it.

title.text: When a judgment shapes what the agent does, you can see the record without digging through the session file.

scene.text: Here all decision rows are enabled. A scripted judge scores whether the command covers the new flag. The extension shows the saved result. Expand tool output to see how it was recorded.

takeaway.text: Read the row to see what the agent had to go on. You can still run the check for actual evidence.
